name: Resistor Environment QA 14
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Potential difference within a loop using Kirchhoff's Loop Rule.

examples.input: A circuit with \SI{12}{\volt} and \SI{6}{\volt} batteries and resistances \SI{2}{\ohm}, \SI{4}{\ohm} forms a loop in the following order if we start from Point A in clockwise. Point A , \SI{6}{\ohm} , \SI{4}{\ohm}, Point B,  \SI{2}{\ohm}, \SI{12}{\ohm} cell. Net current flow in clockwise direction. What is the potential difference VA - VB in this network?
